Interim recorded answers of the Stats API, for the package tests.

Every row here is made up. Vault and wallet addresses are 0x plus SHA-256
of a bca-fixture string. Every vault name starts with Fixture. The
exchanges are test-exchange-a, test-exchange-b and test-exchange-c. The
lookup sentences are the pinned method text of address-index-2, not rows.

How they were made: the rules of design-final.md (its reference script,
stats_reference.py, SHA-256 7d5b932f7492a33c3fd85848a5005270a87ec236bdb9363ab26517ba34d62693)
were run over a made-up night folder of 2026-11-24, and each data block
was put in the API's envelope: meta.status, meta.diagnostic, pageInfo,
one citation to the open file, and the demo tier.

answers/ holds one call each: the tool, its arguments, the request the
package must send, and the API's answer. expected_outputs/ holds what the
package hands the model for that answer, with the marker id
0123456789abcdef and the call id fedcba9876543210
(tests/test_stats_tools.py). SHA256SUMS covers both folders.

To replace: when the dump of task A1 exists (scripts/dump_stats_answers.py
in the API), copy it here, make expected_outputs again, update SHA256SUMS,
and check that the TypeScript package's expected outputs are the same.
